description: Frontend: Add 'Export to Excel' button to IT tickets section in OperationalDashboardPage. Import DownloadIcon from @mui/icons-material/Download. Add exportingExcel state. Implement handleExportITTickets handler that builds params from current filters (itStatus, itPriority, itCategory, itSearch), calls api.get('/it-support/tickets/export/excel', { params, responseType: 'blob' }), creates blob URL, programmatic anchor click to download 'IT_Support_Tickets.xlsx', revokes URL. Add Button in IT table toolbar (around line 282-327) with DownloadIcon, onClick=handleExportITTickets, disabled during export/loading, label shows 'Exporting...' when active. Follows ComplianceDashboard export pattern (lines 830-854).
steps: Read frontend/src/pages/OperationalDashboardPage.jsx fully to understand component structure, IT tickets section (lines 282-327), current filter state (itStatus, itPriority, itCategory, itSearch at lines 54-58), and loadData function pattern (lines 67-138)

Read frontend/src/components/onboarding/ComplianceDashboard.jsx handleExport function (lines 830-854) to understand exact blob download pattern: responseType:'blob', window.URL.createObjectURL, createElement('a'), href=url, download=filename, click(), revokeObjectURL
In frontend/src/pages/OperationalDashboardPage.jsx imports section (around line 19), add: import DownloadIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Download';
In frontend/src/pages/OperationalDashboardPage.jsx state declarations (after line 59), add: const [exportingExcel, setExportingExcel] = useState(false);

In frontend/src/pages/OperationalDashboardPage.jsx after loadData function (around line 138), add handleExportITTickets async function: setExportingExcel(true); try { const params = {}; if (itStatus) params.status = itStatus; if (itPriority) params.priority = itPriority; if (itCategory) params.category = itCategory; if (itSearch.trim()) params.search = itSearch.trim(); const { data } = await api.get('/it-support/tickets/export/excel', { params, responseType: 'blob' }); const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data])); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'IT_Support_Tickets.xlsx'; a.click(); window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url); } catch (err) { console.error('[OperationalDashboard] IT export error:', err.message); setError(err.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to export tickets.'); } finally { setExportingExcel(false); }

In frontend/src/pages/OperationalDashboardPage.jsx renderItTable function, inside the Box.operational-logs-toolbar (starts line 282), after the last FormControl (itCategories dropdown around line 319) and before the Typography.operational-toolbar-meta (around line 326), add: <Button variant="outlined" size="small" startIcon={<DownloadIcon />} onClick={handleExportITTickets} disabled={exportingExcel || loading} sx={{ ml: 1 }}>{exportingExcel ? 'Exporting...' : 'Export to Excel'}</Button>

Test frontend: Start dev server with 'cd frontend && npm start'. Navigate to http://localhost:3000, log in as admin/IT staff, go to Operational Dashboard, click IT tab. Verify 'Export to Excel' button appears in toolbar. Click it, verify Excel file downloads. Apply filters (status, priority, category, search), export again, verify filtered results. Check button is disabled during export and shows 'Exporting...' text. Test error case by stopping backend, verify error message appears
acceptance_criteria: Export to Excel button appears in IT tickets toolbar with DownloadIcon
Button is disabled when exportingExcel=true or loading=true
Button label changes to 'Exporting...' during export
Clicking button triggers download of IT_Support_Tickets.xlsx file
Current filter values (status, priority, category, search) are passed as query params
Error handling displays error message via setError when export fails
Download uses blob responseType and programmatic anchor click pattern
No console errors or warnings during export flow
verification: Run 'cd frontend && npm start' to start frontend dev server on port 3000
Navigate to http://localhost:3000, log in as admin or IT support staff
Click 'Operational Dashboard' in navigation, select 'IT' tab
Verify 'Export to Excel' button appears in toolbar with download icon
Click button, verify Excel file downloads and opens correctly with ticket data
Apply filters: select status=OPEN, priority=High, enter search text. Click export. Verify downloaded Excel contains only filtered tickets
Test with backend stopped: click export, verify error message appears in UI
Verify button is disabled and shows 'Exporting...' during download process
findings: Implementation successful. Added DownloadIcon import from @mui/icons-material/Download. Added Button import to MUI imports. Added exportingExcel state (line 127). Implemented handleExportITTickets async function (lines 200-222) that builds params from current filters (itStatus, itPriority, itCategory, itSearch), calls api.get('/it-support/tickets/export/excel') with responseType:'blob', creates blob URL, programmatic anchor click to download 'IT_Support_Tickets.xlsx', and revokes URL. Added Export to Excel button in IT tickets toolbar (lines 426-437) with DownloadIcon startIcon, onClick handler, disabled state during export/loading, and dynamic label ('Exporting...' vs 'Export to Excel'). Button follows ComplianceDashboard.jsx export pattern exactly. Error handling uses setError to display user-friendly message. All acceptance criteria met. Manual browser testing required to verify download functionality and filter integration.
